'''Syndicate One''' was a company that was originally a subsidiary of [[Trigdale Metallurgy]]. Although initially concerned with marketing, they eventually specialized in the production of a variety of weapons. The company was run by [[Saujutta-Ok-Topii]] and based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Valgauth/Legends|Valgauth]]. [[Saujutta-Ok-Topii]] erected a front for Syndicate One, [[Executive Results]].<ref name="Yard" />
